bearing_definition: wrap(atan2(goal_east, goal_north) - yaw); compared with the same direct-to-goal bearing from current privileged truth. LOS-PID steering itself uses a cross-track lookahead heading and is intentionally not identical to direct bearing.
interpretation_notes: Sample-time comparisons isolate sensor noise/bias from configured sensor latency and sample-and-hold.
Current-time comparisons include the intended latency and low-rate GPS hold.
